    import numpy as np

    caps = np.asarray(feasible_remaining_capacities, dtype=np.float64)
    if caps.shape[0] == 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float64)

    item = float(current_item)
    residual = caps - item  # >= 0 by feasibility
    caps_safe = np.where(caps > 0.0, caps, 1.0)

    # strict best-fit primary term: smaller residual scores higher

    return (best_fit + slack_penalty).astype(np.float64)
